discussion_comments.comment_body: why are we removing this? This is going to impact reality of arm template deployment.

This has been removed to address the build failure with error: ##[error]D:\a\1\s\quickstarts\microsoft.databricks\databricks-all-in-one-template-for-vnet-injection-with-nat-gateway\main.bicep(165,5) : Warning no-unnecessary-dependson: Remove unnecessary dependsOn entry 'nsg'. [https://aka.ms/bicep/linter/no-unnecessary-dependson]
	
Referred below docs and as per these "when one resource refers to another resource’s name, ID, or properties, Bicep automatically understands that the dependent resource must be deployed after the one it's referencing."
[Linter rule - no unnecessary dependsOn entries - Azure Resource Manager | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-resource-manager/bicep/linter-rule-no-unnecessary-dependson?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
[Set resource dependencies in Bicep - Azure Resource Manager | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-resource-manager/bicep/resource-dependencies)

+param tags object = {}
+

+
+// Create a short, unique suffix, that will be unique to each resource group
+var uniqueSuffix = substring(uniqueString(resourceGroup().id), 0, 4)
+
+// Dependent resources for the Azure Machine Learning workspace
+module aiDependencies 'modules/dependent-resources.bicep' = {
+  name: 'dependencies-${name}-${uniqueSuffix}-deployment'

+    storageName: 'st${name}${uniqueSuffix}'
+    keyvaultName: 'kv-${name}-${uniqueSuffix}'

+  }
+}
+
+module aiResource 'modules/ai-resource.bicep' = {
+  name: 'ai-${name}-${uniqueSuffix}-deployment'

+    // workspace organization

+    aiResourceFriendlyName: aiResourceFriendlyName
+    aiResourceDescription: aiResourceDescription

+    tags: tags
+
+    // dependent resources

+
+  }
+  dependsOn: [

dependsOn: [ storage ]

you need to add this line to maintain the resource creation in a flow, if deployment script resource get ceated first without storage, it will fail as it is requiring the container.
remove dependsOn when you've added the parent syntax
